# Edge detect (Sobel, Canny)

Finds edges in the image itself (not the 3D geometry, unlike outline): Sobel gradients of brightness, optionally thinned to one-pixel lines as Canny does, over the image, on paper, or glowing on black.

<EffectDemo effect="edges" />

## Usage

```ts
import { EffectComposer } from '@mk7s/xtree/core';
import { edges } from '@mk7s/xtree/effects/edges';

const composer = new EffectComposer(renderer);
composer.setScene(scene, camera);
composer.add(edges({ preset: 'blueprint' }));
renderer.setAnimationLoop(() => composer.render());
```

Every parameter is also a property: `effect.method = 'sobel'`. Uniform changes take effect on the next frame without recompiling; parameters marked _structural_ recompile the pass that contains the effect.

## Parameters

| Parameter               | Type                                                          | Default     | Range      | Description                                                          |
| ----------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------- | ---------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `method` _(structural)_ | 'sobel' \| 'canny'                                            | `'sobel'`   |            | Sobel draws every gradient; Canny keeps only the ridge of each edge. |
| `threshold`             | number                                                        | `0.25`      | 0 – 2      | Gradient strength that counts as an edge.                            |
| `thickness`             | number                                                        | `1`         | 0.5 – 4 px | Spacing of the samples, which sets the line width.                   |
| `style` _(structural)_  | 'overlay' \| 'ink' \| 'glow'                                  | `'overlay'` |            | Lines over the image, ink on paper, or bright lines on black.        |
| `color`                 | hex color (theme: [`accent`](/guide/holocss#theme-roles))     | `'#7cc4ff'` |            | Line color.                                                          |
| `paper`                 | hex color (theme: [`background`](/guide/holocss#theme-roles)) | `'#f3efe6'` |            | Ink style: background color.                                         |

Every effect also has `blend` (any of the 26 [blend modes](/reference/shaders#modes)), `opacity` (0–1) and `enabled`.

## Presets

| Preset      | Settings                                                                  |
| ----------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `blueprint` | `style: 'ink'`, `color: '#e8f0ff'`, `paper: '#123a73'`, `method: 'canny'` |
| `neon`      | `style: 'glow'`, `color: '#ff4fd8'`, `threshold: 0.15`                    |
| `comic`     | `style: 'overlay'`, `color: '#111111'`, `thickness: 1.5`                  |
| `sketch`    | `style: 'ink'`, `color: '#333333'`, `method: 'canny'`, `threshold: 0.12`  |

Apply one with `edges({ preset: 'name' })` or `effect.applyPreset('name')`; presets start from the defaults.

## Details

- **Family:** Stylization · tracked as story X8.4 in the [plan](https://github.com/s4njee/xtree/blob/main/plan.md).
- **Passes:** samples the pass input at other positions, so it starts a new merged pass; following pixel effects join that pass.
- **Masks:** set `effect.mask` to a texture, depth range or selection to limit where it applies; see [masks](/guide/masks).
- **Motion:** Static: nothing animates.
- **Size:** 7.4 KB gzip budget for `@mk7s/xtree/effects/edges`, including the shared effect runtime.

## Credits

Original implementation (MIT). References: Sobel operator (Sobel and Feldman, 1968); Non-maximum suppression after Canny, A computational approach to edge detection, 1986.

## Related

- [Outline](./outline) — Draws lines where the depth or the surface direction changes, for a toon or technical-drawing look.
- [Emboss](./emboss) — Presses the image into a relief lit from one side: edges facing the light rise, the others sink.
- [Pencil sketch](./pencil) — Redraws the scene as a pencil sketch on paper: contours from the geometry (depth and normals) and the image, and shading in diagonal strokes that pile up in the shadows.
